newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - S.AFRICAN JUNE TRADE SURPLUS 4.15 BLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - S.AFRICAN JUNE TRADE SURPLUS 4.15 BLN RAND.

text.p: surplus of 4.149 billion rand in June from a 1.75 billion rand
surplus in May, latest South African Revenue Service (SARS)
A Reuters consensus poll of economists forecast the trade
balance would show a 1.28 billion rand surplus in June.
SARS noted in a statement, however, that due to certain
consignments of crude oil which were not cleared timeously, data
for mineral products imports were lower by one billion rand.
Mineral products imports in June 1997 came to 497.7 million
rand according to the latest data.
It said the correction would be reflected in the statement
